info.title: Status List Validator
info.description:
Checks the validity of one or more Referenced Tokens against a Token Status List following draft-ietf-oauth-status-list-10.

Flow
1. Receive idx, uri, and validation_context (single check) or a list of such checks (batch).
2. Fetch the Status List Token JWT from uri.
3. Validate the x5c certificate chain via the configured trust validator, using validation_context.
4. Verify the JWT signature using the leaf certificate public key.
5. Decompress the lst field and extract the bit at position idx.
6. Return whether the token is valid or invalid (revoked).

Results are cached per URI (TTL driven by the JWT ttl/exp claims, default 12 h).

post.description:
Checks the revocation/validity status of one or more Referenced Tokens identified by their index in a Token Status List JWT.

Single-check mode: send `idx`, `uri`, and `validation_context` directly in the body.

Batch mode: send a `checks` array, each item containing `idx`, `uri`, and `validation_context`. Batch requests are capped at 100 items.

On the first call for a given uri the service fetches and verifies the remote JWT and caches it. Subsequent calls for the same uri are served from cache.

200.description: Status check completed successfully. For single-check mode, inspect the `valid` field — a `200` does **not** imply the token is valid, only that the check itself succeeded. For batch mode, inspect each item's `valid` or `error` field independently — a `200` only means the batch request itself was well-formed.

results.error: Certificate chain in Status List Token was rejected by the trust validator

400.description: Bad request — missing or invalid fields, index out of range, or (for batch mode) an empty or oversized `checks` array.

value.error: Index 999999 is out of range for this Status List (list covers indices 0–65535)

403.description: Trust validation failed — the `x5c` certificate chain in the Status List Token JWT was rejected by the trust validator. Applies to single-check mode only; in batch mode this is reported per-item with a `200` overall.

value.error: Certificate chain in Status List Token was rejected by the trust validator

502.description: Upstream error — could not fetch the Status List Token from the issuer, or the JWT failed signature/claim verification. Applies to single-check mode only; in batch mode this is reported per-item with a `200` overall.

value.error: HTTP error fetching status list from https://issuer.example.com/status/1: 503 Server Error

get.description: Returns `200 OK` when the service is running. Suitable for use as a Docker / load-balancer health probe.

idx.description: Zero-based index of the Referenced Token within the Status List.

uri.description: URL of the Status List Token endpoint. Must be an HTTP or HTTPS URL.

validation_context.description: Context string used by the trust validator to evaluate the certificate chain (e.g. a trust anchor or policy identifier). Must be a non-empty string.

checks.description: List of individual status checks to perform. Each item has the same shape as a single StatusRequest.

valid.description: true only when the status value is 0x00 (VALID).

status.description:
Raw integer status value extracted from the Status List.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | VALID |
| 1 | INVALID (revoked) |

status_description.description: Human-readable label for the status value.

cached.description: true if the Status List was served from the in-memory/Redis cache rather than fetched live from the issuer.

BatchStatusResultItem.description: Result of a single check within a batch. Either the StatusResponse fields are present (success) or `error` is present (failure) — never both.

index.description: Zero-based position of this check within the original `checks` array, for correlating results back to requests.

status_code.description: The HTTP status code that would have been returned had this check been made individually (200, 400, 403, or 502).

valid.description: Present on success. true only when the status value is 0x00 (VALID).

status.description: Present on success. Raw integer status value extracted from the Status List (0 = VALID, 1 = INVALID).

status_description.description: Present on success. Human-readable label for the status value.

cached.description: Present on success. true if served from cache.

error.description: Present on failure. Human-readable error message for this specific check.

example.error: Certificate chain in Status List Token was rejected by the trust validator

results.error: Certificate chain in Status List Token was rejected by the trust validator
